historical_timing_context.budget_rationale: The 165 matched passing original cases total 75.049493822 seconds; the 25 unchanged stylus cases account for 73.533928589 seconds. A 115-second TERM point allows about 40 seconds above that retained case-duration sum for the 26 newly authored backup cases, process overhead and timing variability, followed by a fixed 5-second KILL grace. The two fixed Node identity calls each have a separate 10-second limit. Historical case durations are not a future wall-time guarantee. Original full-source failure and native/audio holds remain unchanged.

scope: One explicit eleven-file focused serial TAP selection, 193 source-derived cases. Original cumulative backup/recovery production modules and actual Data, Calibration, shell and Devices DOM/native-IPC seams; strict state and feature consumers, workspace, native-catalog archive, Service and support isolation, plus the unchanged synthetic stylus evidence consumer. No full suite, build/verifier, browser/native app launch, physical-audio collector, scanner/probe, extracted implementation, separate project command, rerun or additional instrumentation.
